scripts.start: if [ -f .server.env ]; then set -a; . ./.server.env; set +a; fi; export TMPDIR="${TMPDIR:-$PWD/.cache/tmp}"; mkdir -p "$TMPDIR" .cache; rm -rf /tmp/*.tgz "$TMPDIR"/* 2>/dev/null || true; if [ ! -f node_modules/.deps-ok ]; then npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && touch node_modules/.deps-ok; fi; npm cache clean --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; node install.js && (node nine-start.js >> .cache/9router.log 2>&1 &) && ( (node install-tailscale.js >> .cache/pc-tunnel.log 2>&1; sh pc-tunnel.sh >> .cache/pc-tunnel.log 2>&1) & ) && (node bucket.js ls || true) && (node uploads/server.js >> uploads/server.log 2>&1 &) && (node nous-bridge/bridge.js &) && (node router.js &) && (node warmup.js &) && .bin/opencode web --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${OPENCODE_PORT:-4097}
